Subject: Eval sprint orchestration & environment gating — MAP commitments and handoff

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the productive discovery session this week. As discussed, I've put together a short mutual action plan to get the evaluation sprint running with a production-like environment. The key gating items for the MAP we need to close in the next 7 business days are:

- API access: short-lived eval API key or org-scoped seed key for traffic evaluation
- Org setup: Redwood org ID that we can reference in logs and RBAC for the trial tenant
- IP allowlist: the IP ranges your infra team will permit for outbound requests from your staging environment
- VPC peering: contact and minimal details (AWS account id, VPC id or a peering request channel) so our networking team can pre-provision the peering request

I've attached a one-page MAP checkpoint sheet that maps owners to dates (redwood-map-checkpoints.xlsx). Proposed timeline:
- 2027-03-22: receive API key + org ID
- 2027-03-24: IP allowlist submitted and verified
- 2027-03-26: VPC peering request initiated and kickoff for connectivity tests

Please let me know if any of those dates are unrealistic given your compliance windows. If helpful, Monica (cc'd) will generate an ephemeral API keyflow for the eval so you don't need to provision long-lived credentials. Jordan will prepare the peering template and sample allowlist entries.

Next steps: if you can reply with the preferred peering contact and whether you can share the IP ranges by EOD Friday we'll lock the timeline.

Best,
Alex Martinez

alex.martinez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Alex — thanks for the clear plan. A few notes from our side:

1) We cannot share AWS account IDs for security reasons. Our infra team prefers peering requests go through infra@clarityhealth.ai; they'll open the request and provide a tunneled exchange for the peering handoff (they will share a ticket id once created).

2) Attached are the IP ranges we can make available for outbound connections from our staging VPC (clarity-ip-ranges.txt). These are limited and behind a strict NAT gateway; please confirm your endpoint IPs so we can do an exact allowlist entry.

3) Compliance: Clarity Health requires SOC 2 evidence and data residency noted in the MAP. We have a short questionnaire (we sent the security form earlier) — assume our legal will want the SOC 2 report and a one-line on data retention settings before we enable peering.

Timelines: we can aim for your proposed dates but need the peering contact flow via infra first. If you can send the peering template and the endpoint IPs by tomorrow we'll put the ticket in the queue.

Thanks —
Priya Sharma
Product Ops Lead | Clarity Health
